name: Glimmerbrook
blurb: The quiet town of Glimmerbrook may have more to it than meets the eye...

neighbourhoods.name: The Magic Realm
neighbourhoods.desc: The Magic Realm is the source of all magic. Unfortunately, it is slowly being pulled apart by the swirling vortex surrounding it. The only thing that is keeping it together is the balance between the three houses of magic.

highlights.name: Magic Portal
highlights.text: There are tales of a portal above the Glimmerbrook waterfall. Are you brave enough to see where it leads?

highlights.name: Casters Alley
highlights.text: Casters Alley within the Magic Realm is your go-to shopping spot for wands, potions, and brooms

highlights.name: Enchantment
highlights.text: Make this a truly magical vacation. Cauldrons are brewing and spells are a-casting here in Glimmerbrook
